To re-pin for a new bundle:
It prints the old -> new diff, refuses to guess `panel_support` when the panel files
changed, and never builds. `panel_support` is then pinned by one effects-only run:
`panel_support` is the PerturbMatch / CD4 target-coverage pair the build asserts. It is
a property of (panel x donor tables), so a new 300-target panel WILL move it and the
old values would abort every D/E/F build.
